main.description: Operator or agent setpoint write to a signal. Routed XRPC → bpmn-dispatcher → AgentGateway MCP → LangServer pod → Zenoh publish per ADR-2605111200. Requires setpoint:write capability on the writing principal and DMN interlock pass.

valueMicroUnit.description: Setpoint value in micro-units (1e-6); must lie within signal euRange

unitCode.description: UCUM unit code (must equal the signal's unitCode)

expectedSuperStep.description: Optional super-step id at which the change should land (for scheduled setpoint cascades)
